text:
nina: Heads up 14A1 We hit duplicate side-effects in onboarding after a token refresh+429. Repro: start streaming draft save -> trigger key rotation -> upstream returns 429 mid-chunk -> SDK retries -> duplicate draft rows.

kevin: Is this happening because the sampleapp stream helper retries at the transport without an idempotency key?

nina: Exactly. The example wraps writes in an optimistic client and doesn't set Idempotency-Key on retry. Node SDK replays; Go SDK errors out. Parity mismatch.

tara: Quick wins: 1) sampleapp transport should attach an idempotency key for any write; 2) SDKs should emit a replay marker header (x-client-replay-hash) when resuming after auth errors; 3) add a tiny randomized jitter to Retry-After handling.

oscar: For jitter: propose sleep = RetryAfter + rand(0, min(1s, RetryAfter*0.1)). Keeps it small but breaks lockstep.

kevin: Also suggest a lint that fails CI if an example calls a write URI without idempotency header. We'll add it to sampleapp CI.

nina: I'll open a sampleapp PR to add the transport-level header and an e2e test that simulates rotation+429 and asserts single row.

tara: I'll coordinate a spec doc for the replay header: name, format (sha256 hex of last-acked-op), rotation handling, and privacy (hash only). Put it in devex docs.

oscar: Telemetry: emit "unsafe_replay_detected" with sdk, replay_hash, and outcome. Only hashed identifiers. Helps find regressions.

ci-bot: pipeline queued: sampleapp/idempotency-fix v1 -> staging at 1973001100 :rocket:

kevin: Long-term: add server-side dedupe guidance in the onboarding docs and a sample SQL migration that adds a unique constraint on idempotency_key for writes.

nina: Cool. Action items: PR for sampleapp transport + lint, SDK parity PRs (node/go), telemetry event, e2e test. I'll post PR links here when opened.

kevin: Thanks 615; small change but big impact.
